body:
Every order at One Stop Vape Store has an order ID, a private status page and, once it ships, a tracking number. Knowing where to look for each one means you always know what is happening with your order and what, if anything, you need to do. This guide explains your order ID, the private status page, each status you may see, how package tracking works, how long it takes to start updating, what to do when nothing seems to move and how to get help. It is written for adults aged 21 and over.

## Your order ID
When you place an order you receive an ID such as OSV-XXXXXX in the confirmation email and on screen. It identifies your order everywhere: in emails, on your private page and when you contact support. Keep it handy, and include it in any message to us, because it lets us find your order immediately. If you pay with an app, add it in the payment note too.

## Where to look
Use the link in your confirmation email to open the private status page. The link contains a unique token, so only someone who has it can open the page, and no sign-in is needed. The page shows the amount due, payment instructions where relevant, the current status and any updates. Bookmark it, or keep the email, because it is the easiest way to check your order at any time. Do not share the link, because it gives access to your order details.

## Status meanings
Your order moves through a sequence of statuses. Each tells you what is happening and whether you need to act.

- **Awaiting payment:** your order is saved and we are waiting for payment or sending you details. For crypto, make or complete the transfer. For Cash App, Apple Pay or Chime, watch for our details. For gift cards, buy the card and upload it.
- **Payment details sent:** we have emailed or messaged you how to pay. Pay the exact amount and upload your receipt.
- **Proof submitted:** you uploaded a screenshot, a transaction hash or gift card details, and we are checking them, normally within business hours.
- **Payment detected on-chain:** a crypto transfer is visible on the network and awaiting confirmation. No action is needed unless it stays that way for a long time.
- **Payment confirmed:** we have confirmed your payment and the order is being prepared. You receive an email.
- **Shipped:** your package has left, and tracking is on its way.
- **Cancelled:** the order was cancelled, for example because payment was not received in time.

A fuller explanation of each is in [order status meanings](/blog/order-status-meanings/).

## Tracking the package
After processing, a tracking email arrives with the carrier and the tracking number. We use regional carriers, so the carrier's name and tracking page may be less familiar than a national courier's. Open the carrier's tracking page, enter the number and follow the progress. Tracking can take some time to start updating after the label is created, because the carrier scans the parcel only when it first moves through its system. A tracking number that shows no movement for a day or two is not unusual.

## What the tracking events mean
Different carriers use different wording, but the stages are similar:

- **Label created:** the carrier has been told about the parcel but does not have it yet.
- **Accepted or picked up:** the parcel is in the carrier's hands.
- **In transit:** it is moving between facilities.
- **Out for delivery:** it is on the vehicle for your address. An adult 21+ must be available to sign.
- **Delivery attempted:** no one was available to sign. The carrier usually leaves a notice and tries again.
- **Delivered:** the parcel has been signed for.

If the event feed pauses for several days, that is common on long routes. Compare the dates with our estimates: 3 to 7 business days in transit for the West Coast and 11 to 18 business days for the eastern half of the US. See [shipping times from Phoenix, Arizona](/blog/shipping-times-from-phoenix-arizona/).

## No update?
Allow the processing time described in the [shipping policy](/shipping/): 24 to 72 business hours after payment is confirmed, excluding weekends and federal holidays. If that time has passed and your status has not changed, or if your tracking has shown nothing for longer than the estimate for your region, contact us through the [contact page](/contact/) with your order ID. We will check the order and the carrier. For late packages, see [what to do if your package is delayed](/blog/what-to-do-if-your-package-is-delayed/).

## Get ready for delivery
Delivery needs an adult aged 21 or older to sign and show government-issued photo ID. Watch the tracking for the out-for-delivery event, and make sure someone is available. Keep your phone number current, because the carrier may call. Read [adult signature on delivery](/blog/adult-signature-on-delivery-what-to-expect/) so you know what to expect, and [discreet packaging](/blog/discreet-packaging-what-to-expect/) for what the parcel looks like.

## If something looks wrong
- **Wrong address on the tracking:** contact us immediately. We can sometimes help before the carrier has the parcel, but not after.
- **Status stuck on awaiting payment:** check whether you completed the payment steps, and look for our email. See [how payment details reach you](/blog/how-payment-details-reach-you/).
- **Proof submitted for a long time:** it is a manual check, quickest during business hours. If it is outside the normal time, contact us.
- **Delivered but you do not have it:** check with neighbors and the delivery address, then contact us. See [damaged or missing items](/blog/damaged-or-missing-items-what-to-do/).

## Tips
- Save your confirmation email and your order ID.
- Keep your phone number current so the carrier can reach you.
- Check the status page after paying, to confirm the order moves forward.
- Use the carrier's tracking page for the latest movement.
- Contact us early, not after weeks, if something looks wrong.

## Frequently asked questions in depth
### Can I track an order without the email?
Contact us with your name and email and we will resend the link. For security, we confirm the details on the order first.

### Why does the carrier show different dates from your estimate?
Carriers publish their own scan times, which can differ from our estimates. Use both as guides.

### Does tracking show the signature?
Most carriers record that the parcel was signed for, and some show the signer's name. It confirms delivery.

### Can I change the address after it ships?
No. After the parcel is handed to the carrier we cannot change the address or contents. See [how to change or cancel an order](/blog/how-to-change-or-cancel-an-order/).

Browse [vape juice](/shop/vape-juice/) and [disposable vapes](/shop/disposables/). All products are for adults aged 21 and over, and nicotine is addictive.

## Tracking tips that save time
### Use the right link for the right question
Our private order page answers questions about payment, processing and our own status. The carrier's tracking page answers questions about where the parcel is. If you are asking "has my payment been confirmed?" use our page. If you are asking "where is my parcel?" use the carrier's page. Mixing them up is the most common reason people think an order is stuck when it is not.

### Set up notifications
Many carriers let you subscribe to text or email updates from the tracking page, using your tracking number. Doing so means you hear about an out-for-delivery event as soon as it happens, which helps you be present to sign. Keep your phone number current on the order so the carrier can reach you if the address needs clarifying.

### Keep a record
Screenshot the tracking page when it shows a delivery attempt or a delivered status. If a parcel is later reported missing or damaged, those records help us and the carrier investigate quickly. Keep your confirmation email, the tracking email and any delivery notices together until the order is complete.

### Know when to wait and when to write
Waiting is right when the tracking is within the estimate for your region and the status is moving, even slowly. Writing to us is right when the estimate has passed, when the tracking shows an exception such as a returned parcel or when the status has not changed for longer than the processing time. Include your order ID and a screenshot of the tracking page, and we can usually tell you what is happening within the same business day.

### Frequently asked questions in depth
**What if the tracking number does not work?** Wait a day. Tracking numbers often take time to activate after the label is created. If it still does not work after a day or two, send us the number and your order ID and we will check it.

**Can I track from my phone?** Yes. Our private order page and the carrier's tracking page both work on a phone, and your confirmation email has the link to the first.

**Will the carrier tell me before delivery?** Many carriers offer text or email alerts if you subscribe through their tracking page. It is worth doing, because it helps you be available to sign.

**What does it mean if tracking says the parcel was returned?** It means the carrier is sending it back, often because no adult was available to sign. Contact us right away with your order ID to discuss the options.
